pr_title: Add right click context menu to beatmap link
pr_body:
Closes #8894 
If you don't have the beatmap/beatmapset context menu will only show "Details" option.
It's quite messy, so I'd like some advice how to clean this up.
pr_comments: I still can't navigate git... Sorry for these pushes ^

the compiler can't figure out what delegate type is supposed to be returned from the ternary; if you cast one of the lambdas to `Action` it will compile. anyways, that is mostly moot as that isn't good code and would likely be solved by one of my earlier suggestions of cleaning up the link class hierarchy properly.

I'm not sure how you tested this but it doesn't seem to be working. In chat the menu item is disabled:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1329837/86205330-8b0ae880-bba4-11ea-9494-bcc599c16228.png)
In user profiles the context menu doesn't pop up at all (e.g. recent section).

Etc...
Re: My first issue, it was just because I hadn't downloaded the beatmap. It probably shouldn't show at all.

> In user profiles the context menu doesn't pop up at all (e.g. recent section).

Okay this is weird, I went through the code and it seems like at least recent section's links should be working fine, because they use `DrawableLinkCompiler` just like chat links. I even added a test context menu that would be added to EVERY link and it worked in chat but didn't in user profile's recent section. 
Recent section's profile link also uses `ToolipText` which should say "view profile", but it also doesn't appear.
Ah, we don't currently have a global context menu so it has to be added per-component and the profile doesn't have one. Fine to ignore that issue.

I wanted to cleanup this code, so on line 117 in `DrawableLinkCompiler` I replaced `game?.ShowBeatmap(getBeatmapIdFromLink(link).Id` with `game?.ShowBeatmap(map.OnlineBeatmapID ?? 0`, but InspectCode says that there's possible `System.NullReferenceException` even though I'm checking for null with `?? 0`.
I even manually set `map.OnlineBeatmapID` to `null` and it didn't throw an exception.
Am I doing something wrong again or is InspectCode wrong?
it's intensely hard to tell without actually seeing the code you wrote, but i'm guessing inspectcode is reporting that `map` *itself* might be null.

I just came back home 2 days ago and tried working on this, but I don't think I'm experienced enough to finish this.
I tried to at least work on [this](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/9365#discussion_r449182467), but for some reason even though `DrawableLinkCompiler`'s width is equal to whole chat line width, the context menu appears only when you right click the link. So when I added a `DrawableBeatmapLink` child (with all right click logic) to `DrawableLinkCompiler` with `RelativeSizeAxes = Axes.Both` the context menu would appear whenever I right click anywhere on the chat line, instead of when I right click the link.

I am going to go ahead and close this pull request due to inactivity, generally incorrect direction, and the author's stated inability to resolve the issues. `DrawableLinkCompiler` is generally the wrong place for link parsing logic - it should solely be a presentation-focused class. The parsing should happen at a higher level.

Another way that may be worth exploring is having the dropdowns and their items associated with `Link`/`LinkDetails` directly somehow - although the current structure of those classes has been called into question before (https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/11754), so cleaning up that area first may be a wise step.

issue_context.title: Add right click context menu to beatmap links to allow immediate presenting at song select
issue_context.body:
**Describe the new feature:** 

Currently clicking "now playing <map>" does open osu!direct. in stable clicking on this leads you directly to the map as long youre in song select. i feel like this should behave the same way in lazer.

**Proposal designs of the feature:** 

Send us directly to the map if you are in song select instead of opening osu!direct
comments: The current behaviour is intentional. You can visit the map by clicking the goto map button.
wouldnt this be more convenient, espacially for phone user?  this would speed things up maybe by not much but that seems more logicable
The idea is to give the user a choice. Clicking something in chat shouldn't change the game's state.

Mh i see. But allow me to make a example.

If youre say streaming and you get a request. You would click on it and you would be send to the map and you can check it out faster because you do have the important stats already shown on the top left on song select. now if youre not having the map however you would be presented with the osu!direct screen and from there youre able to choose to Download/Play it or not. 

While i do see the logic behind not changing the game's state. i think for most people it would be favoured to not greeted each time with a osu!direct screen. Or at the very least giving users the choice because all whats really happening is moving from SongSelect to the song. Not from a different menu to song select to the song. you dont really get kicked out of the screen or anything. while with this current option you do get this "overlay" forced upon you. would be nice to give this over the time a different thought or approach.
Could add a right click menu for that, I guess.
This would be a welcome solution to this imo. 👍
So the context menu should have options "open in osu!direct" and "open in song select" with the other being inactive if you haven't downloaded it?

"Go to beatmap"
"Details..." (this matches right click at song select)

review_comments:
So I'll elaborate on the problem I have with the way this is done. In my view it's unorganised - this is doing link parsing on-the-fly where presumably some places have already *done* such parsing and/or might want to do that parsing on their own again.

What I'd like to see here is introduction of a `BeatmapLink` or a `BeatmapSetLink` model (so *only* and *strictly* data, ideally immutable, too) that is already parsed *once*, at a *higher* level, which has the beatmap ID stored into a sane structure that can just be read here without doing this split & parse locally.
i find this very weird. don't represent invalid data in-band like this by coercing to 0, use an `int?` instead.

And this is problem number 2 in this for me. Going forward I presume we might want to handle news links, wiki links, etc. `DrawableLinkCompiler` is a very general class. I would be strongly opposed to all logic handling dispatch of links to game views landing in this huge getter in the future.

The way I would propose this to be resolved is by having analogues to the link types (so i.e. `DrawableBeatmapLink` and `DrawableBeatmapSetLink`). Each of these will have their own logic for context menu, their own options, etc., all scoped down and not everything-at-once. I don't see this as over-engineering as we know we might need this in the future already.
